Trove report: this month (since Oct 1)
Only 13 requests so far, so these numbers are rough. They firm up as you use
your agent.

Headline
  Spend        ~$0.13 (estimated at list prices, not an invoice); 372K tokens
               (measured)
  From history 13 requests in 3 sessions read from your agent's local logs
               (estimated, not seen by the gateway). Plan: API key (estimated
               from local settings), so this counts as spend
  Waste found  none yet (estimated)
  Savings      none yet; no optimizer has been on (estimated)
  Measured     not enough data yet to compare sessions with and without an
               optimizer. The dollar savings above are estimates.

Cache rebuilds (Claude Code history)
  8 rebuilds wrote 243K tokens to the cache again (measured), 86% of all cache
  writes in this period.
  Cause (estimated)             Count  Tokens  Share
  Idle past the cache lifetime      1     36K    15%
  Model changed                     1     37K    15%
  Subagent's first request          1     22K     9%
  Compaction                        1     25K    10%
  Claude Code version changed       1     25K    10%
  Effort level changed              1     31K    13%
  Fast mode switched                1     32K    13%
  Unexplained                       1     35K    14%
  A rebuild is a cache write over 20K tokens and over 3 times the content that
  was new since the agent's previous request.
  Not counted: 1 session start, which build a cache rather than rebuild one (30K
  tokens, measured).
  Unexplained covers causes the log does not show (an MCP server, plugin or tool
  list that changed) as well as possible Claude Code bugs.

Output by kind (Claude Code history)
  7K output tokens (measured): thinking 3.3K (estimated), visible text ~2.4K,
  tool input ~625.

  After a prompt              4.5K     ~2.9K  ~1.4K        ~225
  Tool-result continuation    1.8K      ~400    ~1K        ~400
  (not recorded) *             700         -      -           -

  Model                Output  Thinking   Text  Tool input
  claude-sonnet-5-5 *    5.5K     ~2.8K  ~1.4K        ~625
  claude-haiku-5-5       1.2K       500   ~700          ~0
  claude-opus-5           300         0   ~300          ~0

  Effort            Output  Thinking   Text  Tool input
  high                3.4K        2K  ~1.3K        ~125
  medium              2.9K     ~1.3K  ~1.1K        ~500
  (not recorded) *     700         -      -           -

  Claude Code       Output  Thinking  Text  Tool input
  2.1.330             5.9K     ~3.3K   ~2K        ~625
  (not recorded) *     700         -     -           -
  2.1.329              300         0  ~300          ~0
  2.1.331              100         0  ~100          ~0
  Output is measured. Thinking is measured where the log has a count; ~ marks
  estimates. Text and tool input are estimated by splitting the rest of the
  output by their byte sizes.
  Bytes per token for sonnet: 3.50 (the prior, too few requests to calibrate).
  * includes 700 output tokens from requests read before Trove recorded sizes;
  they count in Output only, and - means none of the row could be split.
  Earlier thinking carried in context: up to 2.6K input tokens over 10 requests
  on models that keep it, <1% of their input (estimated upper bound).

Biggest leaks (estimated, overlapping, not additive)
  No waste found yet.

Optimizers
  Optimizers act on live requests, so they need the gateway. Your history above
  is read-only. To route your agent through the gateway, run `trove setup
  --gateway`.

Recommendations (suggestions only; Trove changes nothing on its own)
  None yet. These need more recorded usage.
